about: I'm an AI-Native Software & Product-Minded Engineer who loves turning abstract ideas into real, production-ready software fast. I'm naturally curious about emerging tech and genuinely enjoy tackling complex problems. Whenever I solve a problem or make a technical or business decision, I rely on solid SWOT analysis and cost-benefit trade-offs rather than gut feelings, making sure every move maximizes upside and profitability while keeping potential losses to a bare minimum. Having started my entrepreneurial journey back in junior high, I bring strong business sense to the table. I pair AI acceleration (ChatGPT, Claude, Claude Code) with solid engineering discipline covering System Design, API/DB Design, Security, Cloud, Docker, TDD, and CI/CD to build products that actually make commercial sense. And when things break, my instinct is to contain the issue fast to reduce risk, then run a 5 Whys root-cause analysis to strengthen our workflows and guardrails so it doesn't happen again.

principles.title: Start with the business problem
principles.body: Before any code, I analyze the problem the business actually has: who it hurts, what it costs, and what success looks like. Software that solves the wrong problem is the most expensive kind.

principles.title: Map the requirements
principles.body: Then I lay out the functional requirements (what the system must do) and the non-functional ones (performance, security, scalability, reliability), so scope and quality bars are agreed before building.

principles.title: Design the system
principles.body: Only then comes System Design: architecture, API and database design, and trade-offs, all traced back to those requirements.

principles.title: Build fast, build real
principles.body: I love turning abstract ideas into real, production-ready software fast. AI acceleration (ChatGPT, Claude, Claude Code) paired with System Design, API/DB Design, Security, Cloud, Docker, TDD, and CI/CD.

principles.title: Decide with evidence
principles.body: Every technical or business decision runs through SWOT analysis and cost-benefit trade-offs, not gut feeling. Maximize upside, keep potential losses to a bare minimum.

principles.title: Contain, then find the root
principles.body: When things break, I contain the issue fast to reduce risk, then run a 5 Whys root-cause analysis to strengthen workflows and guardrails so it does not happen again.
